''See also: [[Netherworld Empress Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Netherworld]] [[Empress]] is a powerful projection or embodiment that represents the ideals of dominance, conquest for order, and absolute rule. Visually, she is depicted with dark hair, amethyst-colored eyes, a [[silver crown]], and ceremonial clothing in shades of black, white, and violet. She is often seen standing over vast battlefields filled with [[destruction]], wielding a bow of darkness that can transform into a spear. The entity's appearance has shifted over time; while she once shared a resemblance to [[Akura Malice]], her likeness eventually transitioned to resemble [[Mercy]]. The [[Empress]] serves as a manifestation of several specific [[Icons]]: the [[Shadow Icon]] for [[shadow madra]], the [[Crown Icon]] for the weight of leadership, the [[Strength Icon]] for physical power, and the [[Bow Icon]] for long-range combat and vision. When summoned via the seventh page, she acts as a reinforcement of [[Authority|authority]] and [[willpower]] for the user.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Netherworld]] [[Empress]] possesses dark hair and eyes that glow like cruel amethyst stars. She is adorned in elaborate ceremonial robes and wears a [[silver crown]].}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|She serves as the embodiment of [[Malice]]'s ideals. Her [[Spiritual pressure|spiritual pressure]] is heavy enough to weigh [[Mercy]] down.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Netherworld]] [[Empress]] exerts a [[Spiritual pressure|spiritual pressure]] that weighs down [[Mercy]], who possesses the ability to summon a projection of her. She also serves as the embodiment of the ideals held by [[Malice]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|She wields a black bow of darkness that can transform into a spear. Her [[spirit]] reflects the [[Shadow Icon]], her body carries the [[Strength Icon]], and she possesses the sight of the [[Bow Icon]].}}
